paper_title: Experimental Search for Hidden Photon CDM in the eV mass range with a Dish Antenna
notes: First dish-antenna search for hidden photon CDM (Suzuki et al., U. Tokyo, arXiv:1504.00118). Upper limit chi ~ 6e-12 (95% CL) quoted for m_gamma' = 3.1 +/- 1.2 eV; encoded as a flat bound over the stated validity range 1.9-4.3 eV (set by PMT sensitivity 300-650 nm). Exact curve shown in Fig. 5 has mild sqrt(m) dependence per eq. (1.1), but only the single representative value is given numerically in text. Assumes DM entirely composed of hidden photons with rho = 0.3 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 2))
